meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以操控真实的浏览器：按你的指令打开网页、分析页面元素，并执行点击、填表、滚动、截图或提取文字等操作，最后把结果反馈给你。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 打开某个网址、操作页面元素或提取网页信息时，它会自动启动浏览器去执行。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并整页截图。
say.note: 会访问网址并保存完整页面截图。

say.text: 打开 example.com，列出页面里所有可点击的链接。
say.note: 它会分析页面并返回可点击链接列表。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can drive a real browser: open pages, inspect elements, click, fill, scroll, screenshot, and extract text/data, then report the results back to you.
howto.when_en: This triggers when the user wants to open a URL, interact with page elements, or extract information from a webpage.

say_en.text: Open example.com and screenshot the full page.
say_en.note: It visits the URL and saves the screenshot.

say_en.text: Open example.com/form; fill username alice, password 123; click Login.
say_en.note: It opens the form, enters values, and submits.

say_en.text: Open example.com and list all clickable links on the page.
say_en.note: It analyzes the page and returns the links.
